text.5a5fb635fbd3d35ab728: Demand forecasting (medium-high short term, medium long term confidence):
text.2dafcfe1623007638cbe: Strong recent quarterly execution and conservative ranges; multiyear demand remains a judgment. Evidence/outcome: Eight consecutive reported quarters meet or exceed original USD revenue range; five above, three within. Management checks customers and their customers and now reports checking data-center build-outs/power. Supports a strong near-term starting path, not automatic 25% growth from today. Counterevidence: Raising 2026 capex from $52-56bn to $60-64bn demonstrates forecast revision rather than perfect foresight. 2023 revenue declined in the historical record. Demand signals may overlap across customers; signed product plans are not end-user monetization.
text.7ab950e151cc5dda919b: Product delivery (high recent, medium forward confidence):
text.ac88eb8a612c73a5681e: Leading-node ramp has revenue and yield evidence; future A14 remains a roadmap. Evidence/outcome: N2 entered high-volume production Q4 2025 and accounts for 8% of Q3 2026 wafer revenue. 7nm-and-below is 79% of wafer revenue. Demonstrated ability to monetize leading nodes, enabling measured persistence in margin/returns. Counterevidence: A14 2027 risk/2028 volume-production objectives are not realized. Node mix and competitor yield improvements can change advantage quickly.
text.a7d6aec04726d4252e1d: Operational ramp competence is visible, with larger overseas execution burden ahead. Evidence/outcome: Arizona first fab high-volume production confirmed in Q4 2024. N2 now ramps across Hsinchu/Kaohsiung; capacity expected to more than double in 2027. Capacity delivers current shipments, but almost 20 fab projects make forward workload unusually large. Counterevidence: Overseas dilution increases as several fabs open. Tool availability, power/water, skills, labor and subsidies can delay economically usable output.
text.12e194717a694b6ac83e: Better utilization and productivity repeatedly beat margin guidance; FX and mix must be separated from skill. Evidence/outcome: Q3 2026 58.7% EBIT margin versus 56-58% guide; Q2 60.3% versus 56.5-58.5%. Q3 gross margin fell 1.3 points as N2 ramp diluted margins, as directionally anticipated. Justifies above-industry mature economics, with explicit fade for foreign-fab cost. Counterevidence: 2025Q3 favorable currency versus guide helped margins; not all beat is cost control. N2 and overseas costs can outlast productivity gains.
text.28cd9400a1e337221ed7: Capital allocation (medium-high historical, medium forecast confidence):
text.54beb0fa4d8a51588475: Investment has supported profitable growth, but new capex is a demanding long-duration commitment. Evidence/outcome: FY2025 operating cash flow TWD2.275tr versus capex TWD1.272tr. Current balance sheet has substantial cash/investments; regular dividends. Model requires reinvestment and returns decay; no valuation premium solely for leadership reputation. Counterevidence: Higher construction/tool cost per wafer and foreign fab economics may depress future incremental returns. Cash/ROE is not ROIC; refundable customer receipts and NCI/leases affect claims. Taiwan continuity risk is outside management control.

# ValuationLab data recommendation
Verified against primary provider documentation on 2026-10-17. No account, key, subscription, purchase, or permission grant was created. Coverage claims below are documented capabilities, not successful entitlement tests for all 14 symbols.

## Recommendation
Use SEC filings and a server-side normalization cache as the free fundamentals backbone. Preserve original filings as immutable evidence. A free, complete, keyless, redistribution-cleared service covering every required valuation field and current prices for arbitrary tickers was not established. Ship source-backed financial snapshots with an explicitly missing or manually entered dated market price until a quote provider and suitable use rights are approved. “Public tickers” does not automatically mean this app may publicly redistribute vendor data.

For personal use after user setup, Alpha Vantage is a plausible free statement/quote supplement; Finnhub is a plausible free as-reported/quote supplement. Do not imply either has authenticated coverage of every required ticker. All vendor adapters should be optional and disabled without configuration. Do not fetch third-party prices through undocumented Yahoo endpoints or a public CORS proxy.

## Free sources
- SEC: no API key; submissions and companyfacts cover domestic and foreign filing forms. Companyfacts includes standard taxonomy, entity-wide facts, not every custom or dimensional disclosure. APIs update as filings arrive, but a company can remain months behind current economic conditions. No browser CORS. API reference:

- SEC fair access: maximum 10 requests/second across the application; use an honest application/contact User-Agent. Recommended implementation cap: 2 requests/second with queue, backoff and cache. On denied access stop; do not rotate routes.

## Implementation and accounting specification (engineering recommendation)
- Resolve symbols through SEC company_tickers.json and submissions metadata; key records by CIK + security identity, not ticker alone. Target AAPL, MSFT, AMZN, GOOG, META, NVDA, TSLA, COHR, LITE, AAOI, NBIS, MU, AVGO, TSM.
- Fundamentals GET:
text.2dff310a8d63aa8a2503:
ta.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json. Preserve a filing's original accession, accepted timestamp and primary document. Use SEC original filing when standard tags are missing or ambiguous.
- Raw files are immutable, keyed by accession and checksum. Current/latest views are derived. Cache lookup lists 24 hours; check submissions periodically server-side and fetch companyfacts when filing history changes. Do not report a refresh as successful merely because an old cached response loaded.
- “As of” historical valuations must filter acceptance <= decision time before selecting facts. Later restatements/comparative numbers cannot enter a historical run. Current companyfacts alone is not a point-in-time database. Preserve original as-filed contexts, units and accession.
- Income/cash-flow duration facts require fiscal start/end matching. Never sum four YTD facts. Build discrete Q2/Q3 from same-year cumulative differences when appropriate, Q4 = FY minus 9M; TTM = four nonoverlapping quarters or FY + current YTD - prior-year comparable YTD. Store component references and formula. Balance sheets use latest instant, never a sum.
- Companyfacts frames are not sufficient to infer issuer fiscal quarters. Different issuers have noncalendar and 52/53-week fiscal years. Fiscal year labels can differ from year in period-end dates.
- Do not fabricate EBITDA, capex, debt, working capital or tax rates when a concept is missing. Define cash versus short-term investments, gross debt versus net debt, and treatment of lease liabilities explicitly. Null means unavailable; reported zero is zero. Store source tags and all adjustments.
- Use current outstanding economic shares for current per-share equity value; weighted-average diluted shares are a different accounting measure. Preserve both and distinguish class-level from issuer-total shares. Alphabet and Meta need class-aware identity. Compare price and share basis after splits without double adjustment.
- TSM requires reporting-currency versus USD ADR price reconciliation and a verified depositary ratio. Never simply divide TWD equity value by ADR count or ordinary-share value by ADR price. NBIS requires checking latest issuer form/taxonomy and continuing-operation comparability after its restructuring. Do not assume foreign private issuers have quarterly 10-Q data; obtain issuer releases/6-K as needed, or label annual-only.
- A vendor-normalized quarterly response may not guarantee point-in-time history. Check filing dates and original source, preserve missing values and provider adjustments. EODHD documents yearly/quarterly Financials and filing_date, currency_symbol and shares history, but this is not proof of historical vintage integrity:

## UI/contract requirements
Use /api/companies?query= and /api/company/:symbol?asOf=... on an owned backend, or a prebuilt static cache clearly labeled snapshot. Browser never receives provider secrets. Validate symbols server-side; no open arbitrary-URL proxy. Provider-specific CORS not established except SEC's explicit no-CORS; backend avoids that dependency and controls licensing/cache policy.

Each numeric field: value (number|null), unit/currency, periodStart, periodEnd, periodType (FY/Q/TTM/instant), filedAt, acceptedAt, accession, form, sourceUrl, sourceTag, status (reported/derived/missing/conflict), derivation and components. Identity: symbol, cik, exchange, securityType, reportingCurrency, quoteCurrency, shareClass, ordinarySharesPerDepositaryShare and verification source.

Separate quote.priceAsOf from financial periodEnd and from fetchedAt. Include lastSuccessfulRefreshAt, latestFilingCheckedAt, nextCheckAt, cacheAge, provider, providerLicenseMode, status and missingFields. Quote: price nullable, raw/adjusted basis, currency, timestamp, delay, source URL. Never label old snapshots live or current simply because fetched today.

Quality flags: annual_only, ttm_incomplete, quote_missing, quote_stale, currency_conversion_missing, adr_ratio_unverified, share_basis_unverified, custom_tag_review, source_conflict, upstream_unavailable. Block misleading per-share/market-upside outputs when quote, FX, ADR ratio or denominator cannot be reconciled. Forecast assumptions remain visibly user assumptions, not fetched facts.

text.ad45c6ecf51d194f4715: Methodology reviewed October 17, 2026. Original implementation choices and explanation; the linked primary sources provide the underlying valuation framework.
text.61aee0a036ce443ac80a: AAOI fresh research uses an explicit staged capacity path. Four sampled scalars (initial growth, mature margin, initial sales/capital, WACC) produce the same documented annual progression in deterministic and simulated cases. Capital intensity fades to (1 + stable growth) × mature margin × (1 − tax) / terminal ROIC. Existing saved linear paths are preserved. Nonpositive mature margin is unsupported for this staged capital mapping; invalid sampled draws are counted and excluded without replacement.
text.f78ac77210051efda4ed: AAOI and Alphabet use source-dated claims adapters in every draw. Selected claim inputs remain fixed; AAOI customer-warrant intrinsic value is recalculated from each scenario's equity. Convertible fair-value deduction and conversion dilution are alternative treatments, never simultaneous. Alphabet preferred conversion endpoints are exogenous contractual scenarios, with cash dividend PV retained; they are not inferred from a current quote or DCF price. These are transparent approximations, not complete option valuations or calibrated probabilities.
text.942f2488a1c31ad3c853: Implemented October 18, 2026. Original research cutoff remains October 17, 2026.
text.f8770b22ddd167969714: Revenue stabilization year: selected 10, 15 or 20. Near-term revenue assumptions are retained, followed by a resampled fade to terminal revenue growth. This does not hold the opening growth rate constant for the entire period.
text.ce76e0874b9beb0620da: Calendar-year economics: margin, tax, discount rate and retained investment commitments have their own timing.
text.2403d1e122246b0fe598: Explicit forecast length: enough rows to include the selected growth horizon and retained economic/commitment years. Selecting growth stability in year 10 can still require 15 or 18 cash-flow rows. Terminal value follows the final explicit row, not an arbitrarily truncated operating path.
text.bd768133c9aeb90185e3: The original research path is distinct from a derived scenario. Selecting the original number of years need not reproduce every source assumption: Micron, for example, has a source explicit endpoint different from its terminal growth. Use research restores the original preset; Undo restores the entire preceding draft.
text.8a83391080afe38d1e45: The first three years are retained for most companies; MSFT, MU and TSM retain five. The rest of the source growth curve is resampled onto the new duration, preserving its shape rather than assuming every company started with a straight-line path. Growth is set to the terminal rate at the selected endpoint and thereafter. Annual and terminal edits can subsequently change that generated path; labels therefore describe the selected horizon rather than claiming it remains an enforced endpoint.
text.d77c0f812442486583f7: Calendar-year margins, tax and WACC are not stretched to match revenue duration. After the source ends, mature terminal assumptions supply new calendar years. Explicitly edited later economics and investment commitments remain in the calculation schedule. Reverting a manual override to its generated value removes that extra retention. Repeated horizon selections use the retained seed and do not compound previously generated paths.
text.fe593c833226843358e0: The new policy is an analyst net-investment sensitivity, not a reconstructed equipment, property, maintenance, working-capital or customer-advance budget. Original component disclosures remain source-only.
text.b4005940b2b7c54d6fc9: For overlapping years, positive baseline investment is kept as a floor and scales upward when revenue exceeds the retained baseline. Additional positive expansion beyond the scaled baseline increment requires capital at an explicit marginal sales/capital assumption. Sales contraction does not automatically create an asset release. A source's signed release is retained once and never enlarged automatically. Manual investment overrides are explicit exceptions, not unreported source facts.
text.6356fe18affab1d3db82: For added mature years, the capital intensity is (1 + stable growth) × mature margin × (1 − mature tax rate) / terminal ROIC. Multiplying this by positive current-year revenue change gives investment equal to NOPAT × growth / ROIC at steady growth under the model's end-year timing. The default marginal sales/capital is the inverse of that intensity. This is a selected modeling convention, not a newly measured company statistic.
text.698c20bca344f6b16e97: Monte Carlo applies the same response using the edited current annual schedule as its baseline, then any independent investment multiplier. Zero stress reproduces the edited deterministic case. Existing v1 simulation behavior is unchanged.
text.880760c9d7b4ed5c5ca6: Damodaran treats growth scalability, sustainable margins and investment quality as separate judgments, and asks analysts to inspect absolute revenue scale and the investment needed for growth.
text.ddea88049fd98a2674a1: Longer growth is not automatically more valuable: returns on investment relative to the required return matter.
text.3e0dbcd273274a3e7f58: Stable reinvestment remains tied to growth and sustainable capital returns.
text.0d3e249844488b2dc4a9: These sources support the underlying principles. The committed-floor-plus-growth policy is this application's disclosed sensitivity implementation, not a formula claimed to be prescribed by Damodaran. Particularly for NBIS, AAOI, cyclical fabs and unresolved capital transitions, a decision-grade alternative needs a component-aware operating/funding forecast.
text.07280f26449128666798: Start with the selected method and active controls in the workspace. Fresh configurations use annual paths. Saved configurations without a method retain legacy scalar sampling; saved growth-only annual configurations retain that scope until annual operating inputs are enabled. The dated scalar explanation below is retained for reference, not a description of every current run.
text.af945d1cb6622df7ae3a: Each active primitive follows Gaussian AR(1) deviations around its edited annual baseline: growth, operating margin, operating tax rate, WACC and capital. Guided uses incremental sales/capital; the Annual model uses a net-investment response factor. Revenue, EBIT, cash tax, NOPAT, FCFF, discount factors and implied capital returns are then calculated once from those inputs. They do not receive duplicate independent shocks.
text.120058d0109de7d4fc43: Annual growth replaces the scalar growth distribution. With annual operating inputs enabled, annual capital replaces the scalar capital distribution or investment multiplier; scalar margin and WACC draws set terminal endpoints only. Optional terminal growth, tax and marginal ROIC are drawn once per scenario and start Fixed. Scalar controls offer Fixed, Triangular, Uniform and Bounded normal distributions; annual innovations remain Gaussian, regardless of that scalar family choice.
text.cd3f00a21acfa8caceb3: Annual innovations are independent across primitives. Persistence connects years within one primitive; it does not create demand–margin or other cross-input dependence. Guided’s optional operating-linked setting concerns remaining scalar draws only, never annual innovations. The Annual model supports independent scalar draws only. Relationships inherited through shared cash-flow calculations are different from modeled correlations between business shocks.
text.6ee5abdfa29565974f48: Innovation SD describes new shocks before conditioning, not the resulting annual path SD or cumulative-revenue uncertainty. Growth, margin, tax and WACC SDs use percentage points; sales/capital uses ratio units and the investment factor uses multiples. Persistence and the distance to exact anchors affect the resulting uncertainty; conditioning narrows it near anchors.
text.2c2d7cdb47dfb58d7766: Selected fixed forecast years keep that primitive’s edited baseline value exactly. They are modeling conditions, not a claim that future guidance is certain. A fixed growth rate does not fix revenue when earlier growth is uncertain. Historical opening facts, source-defined timing stubs, protected funding and the terminal continuation are separate constraints; clearing user-selected fixed years does not remove them.
text.4b189f403264739c2263: Paths are conditioned on selected fixed years and terminal endpoints. Zero SD removes residual innovation noise, but a changed terminal endpoint can still move the conditional mean between anchors. Zero SD with unchanged baseline endpoints reproduces the baseline path. Sampled terminal growth applies from the selected maturity year across its stable plateau; a conflicting user-fixed year requires removing that anchor or keeping terminal growth fixed at baseline.
text.822584697d7cd936e9a6: Defaults are assumptions, including zero-width references
text.e73e6b6c0db423baf807: Fresh research configurations for the original 14 companies use a 3 percentage-point growth innovation SD, 0.6 persistence and exact forecast years 1–3. New operating-metric SDs are zero; company-specific scalar margin and WACC settings may still vary terminal endpoints. These are illustrative choices, not calibrated volatility or certainty estimates. Inactive scalar growth or investment settings do not drive annual-path results.
text.e6df3505685623db4264: Fresh/reset references for KLAC, AMAT, LRCX, ASML, FN, CDNS and SNPS use zero annual SDs, no user-selected exact forecast years, fixed terminal distributions and fixed scalar stresses. Persistence is an inactive zero placeholder only while SDs and baseline endpoints remain unchanged. These runs repeat the selected conditional reference value; they do not estimate a confidence range. Saved configurations remain preserved and can differ.
text.ca31c50937a71b903952: Capital, discounting and claims follow the selected model
text.aefde0e607b8f64ab385: The Annual model retains the selected fixed-schedule, revenue-scaled or committed-floor-plus-growth capital response. Annual investment factors apply after that response. A factor of 1 preserves edited pre-reserve investment under fixed-schedule; revenue-responsive policies can change it. Protected fixed funding is not multiplied, and required operating-cash changes are derived separately. Direct signed dollar-investment paths are supported only with fixed-schedule.
text.04b57a9af55a3d766a41: Fixed investment does not automatically rebuild capacity when revenue changes. Revenue scaling is a proportional sensitivity, not a complete capacity, maintenance-capex or working-capital model. Annual WACC paths feed the existing discount-factor calculation; terminal cash flow retains reinvestment for sampled growth and ROIC. Source facts, horizon, timing and dated claims inputs remain fixed, while scenario-dependent claim allocations are recalculated where the selected model requires them.
text.80b0afe914828a86cd8a: Run explicitly and read accepted outcomes
text.8e0587ef76d5426e08bf: Changing assumptions does not start a simulation. Choose Run simulation to calculate new results; edits make previous results stale. Chart replay uses already-computed outcomes and creates no new draws. Reproducibility requires the same source, edited baseline, active settings, seed and software version. Exports identify annual paths, terminal draws, input scopes and exclusions.
text.3ec09dd19ab776a84d8c: The requested trial count is an attempt count. Out-of-domain or numerically invalid paths are excluded without clipping or replacement. Frequencies and quantiles are conditional on accepted outcomes; review exclusion reasons and counts. Some bounds are application limits, not universal economic impossibilities. Excluded paths are not a default probability, and plausible business failure is not modeled by discarding invalid inputs.
text.b1a10d447c70b2c02edb: Read the selected output basis and bridge coverage. The Annual model starts with signed operating enterprise value; equity and per-share results require an eligible source-dated allocation. Its general signed outputs differ from Guided’s zero per-share floor; source-specific allocation rules, including Fabrinet’s zero ordinary value for a nonpositive allocation pool, still apply. Annual research supplies no verified current-price comparison. Missing claims, shares or quotes are not filled with zero.
text.2baa3d9325af90e5a57e: Quantiles describe these assumptions and constraints, not statistical confidence in true value, a stock-price forecast or a chance of profit. More trials improve numerical precision within the assumed model. They do not calibrate the business story, correct missing dependencies or create a financing, distress or recovery model.
text.83518b1eb8822cc65094: Damodaran’s framework draws important uncertain inputs and revalues the business; it allows annual draws and dependence across inputs and time. The Gaussian AR(1) bridge, exact future anchors, independence assumptions and defaults here are this app’s choices. They are not parameters prescribed or endorsed by Damodaran. The dated historical reference below explains the original scalar implementation and bounded-normal mathematics.
text.ebe4450adec4d0fe532f: Damodaran: Dealing with Distress in Valuation, Steps in Simulation
text.a124f2956f8626694066: Historical scalar implementation · retained 17 October 2026 reference
text.e74903194ca863d42138: The original explanation below is preserved as a dated historical implementation record. Its single-vector paths, constant-WACC claims, company gates, four-driver defaults and source-specific claim descriptions must not be read as the current annual method or as a promise of today’s legacy-mode behavior. Use the current explanation above and the selected workspace controls for the active calculation.
text.3d3e71c4e3b86327415a: Paths are conditioned on selected fixed years and terminal endpoints. Zero SD removes residual innovation noise, but a changed terminal endpoint can still move the conditional mean between anchors. Zero SD with unchanged baseline endpoints reproduces the baseline path. Sampled terminal growth applies from the selected maturity year across its stable plateau; a conflicting user-fixed year requires removing that anchor or keeping terminal growth fixed at baseline. All explicitly fixed years retain their baseline values even when the terminal continuation changes.
text.53f4f021bdebbcefcd9b: The Annual model retains the selected fixed-schedule, revenue-scaled or committed-floor-plus-growth capital response. Annual investment factors apply after that response. A factor of 1 preserves edited pre-reserve investment under fixed-schedule; revenue-responsive policies can change it. Protected fixed funding is not multiplied, and required operating-cash changes are derived separately. Direct signed dollar-investment paths are supported only with fixed-schedule. A selected company funding floor can add a top-up after the investment response; see that case’s funding explanation.
text.c6d0060f771d8ccb264d: Annual growth replaces the scalar growth distribution. With annual operating inputs enabled, annual capital replaces the scalar capital distribution or investment multiplier; scalar margin and WACC draws set terminal endpoints only. Optional terminal growth, tax and marginal ROIC are drawn once per scenario and start Fixed. Scalar controls offer Fixed, Triangular, Uniform and Bounded normal distributions; annual innovations remain Gaussian, regardless of that scalar family choice. Guided terminal sales/capital is derived from terminal growth, margin, tax and ROIC rather than drawn independently.
